controls.description: TTL is fresh before its boundary, expired at/after it; only a new observation recovers.
Unknown, false and integer zero remain distinct.
Late receipt and identical replay retain original event age and first receipt.
Future observation time and clock regression cannot produce ready context.
Lower or reused producer sequence cannot replace current state, including another key in that stream.
Independent source disagreement retains both observations and blocks readiness.
Exact logical duplicate is idempotent; inconsistent event-ID reuse is rejected.
A dependency update invalidates a derived fact and its snapshot; unrelated generation change does not.
Heartbeat and messages without a relevant fact change neither renew observation time nor request rebuild.
A ready snapshot from account A cannot be reused for B even when per-key versions coincide.
Transitive mandatory closure fits exactly at six units; five cannot omit a required member.
Missing or unknown mandatory facts block readiness; optional unknown is explicitly omitted.
Optional ranking is stable; repeated identical requests yield identical projections.
Revocation fixture invalidates its dependent plan but no fixture implements a grant authority.
Unchanged snapshot validates; a new critical observation invalidates it even at an equal value.
Expiry backstop requests observation without a received change event or an LLM call.
Pre-action check covers critical dependency closure, not unrelated expired facts.
Unknown external outcome stays unknown; it confers neither success nor retry authority.

limitations: One synthetic integer clock domain; clock regression stays invalid until a new model.
The finite authored cases are not exhaustive, independent, or an external benchmark.
Abstract positive integer costs are not measured model tokens.
All source conflicts are conservatively retained; there is no trust-ranking adjudication.
Refresh flags request a hypothetical rebuild or observation; no external call is made.
A false fixture can be structurally ready; readiness never grants permission.

provenance.design: author-designed predeclared finite contract, not independent preregistration

unimplemented: real sensors, tools, permissions, effects, LLM context/token accounting
distributed clock synchronization and restart recovery
causal ordering across independent producer streams
persistence, authenticated sources/snapshots, adversarial access control
optimal refresh scheduling, calibrated uncertainty or value of information
general autonomous intentions, empirical agent outcomes and native admission
